translations.空场和不可约确实值得查，但能不能先给出具体日期、时段和场地？不然还分不清是取消没: Empty courts that cannot be booked do warrant checking. Could someone give the exact date, time slot and court? Otherwise we cannot tell whether a cancellation was not released, there was a temporary arrangement, or maintenance was changing over.
translations.三天空场和小程序不可约这个现象值得查，但还不能直接等同于“内部占用”。有人知道取: Three days of empty courts shown as unavailable are worth investigating, but that does not establish internal use. Does anyone know how soon cancellations are released, or whether bookings are cleared automatically if nobody arrives?
translations.连续三天看到空场但显示不可约，确实值得查；不过“内部占用”还只是猜测。有没有人记: Seeing empty courts marked unavailable for three days deserves investigation, but internal use is still speculation. Has anyone recorded the dates, slots and court numbers? Comparing cancellation and no-show release rules would help distinguish a system issue from a booking-rule issue.
translations.空场但不可约这个现象确实该查，不过“内部占用”先别直接下结论。能不能先说明预约成: Empty but unavailable courts deserve a check, but let's not conclude internal use yet. How long after a booking starts without check-in is it released? Is there a waitlist or a way to book temporarily empty courts? Getting a court is so difficult.
translations.空场和“不可约”最好先确认是不是同一块场地、同一时段，不然容易把切场或维护看成占: First check that the empty court and the unavailable booking refer to the same court and slot. A changeover or maintenance could look like someone holding a booking. How are cancellations and no-shows cleared?
translations.能不能先查一下取消或过期预约的释放时限？如果成功预约后没到场，系统会不会自动核销: Could we first check the release time for cancelled or expired bookings? If someone books but never arrives, is the slot cleared automatically or held? That is easier to verify than guessing about internal use.
translations.如果能补一张同一场地同一时段的预约页面记录，或说明页面显示“不可约”的具体时间，: Would a booking-page record for that exact court and time, including when it showed unavailable, help distinguish an unreleased booking from a protected slot?
translations.我也遇到过约不上但不清楚是不是同一块场地。有人能说下具体日期、时段和场号吗？尤其: I have also failed to book, though I do not know if it was the same court. Can someone give the date, slot and court number? I particularly want to know how soon cancellations or no-shows become bookable again.
translations.你提到的释放和核销规则很关键。我还想确认一下：取消或过期后，页面显示不可约会不会: The release and clearance rules you mentioned matter. Does the unavailable display have a stated update time after cancellation or expiry?
translations.如果有人刚好记了预约时间，最有用的是补上“取消/过期后多久重新可约”以及未签到是: If someone recorded their booking, the most useful additions would be how long after cancellation or expiry it became available, and whether no-shows are released automatically. Those would help distinguish system lag from a slot being held.
translations.如果要继续查，最好把同一场地同一时段的日期记下来，再对照取消后释放和未签到核销时: For further checks, record the date for the same court and time slot, then compare cancellation release and no-show clearance times. That also helps rule out teaching or event reservations.
translations.如果有人实际遇到过，能不能说下取消后多久会重新放号、预约成功但没到场会不会自动释: If someone has experienced this, how soon after cancellation did the slot reopen, and are no-shows released automatically? Those two rules could rule out some guesses.
translations.如果能查到预约成功后的签到或核销记录就更好：没到场多久释放、取消后多久恢复？这比: Check-in or clearance records would help: how long before a no-show is released, and how soon after cancellation does availability return? That distinguishes system delay from actual occupancy better than an empty court alone.
translations.可以再补一个复现办法：同一场地同时截下现场占用状态和小程序页面，并记录取消或过期: Here is a way to reproduce it: record the court's occupancy and the app display at the same time, along with cancellation or expiry times. That separates protected slots, maintenance and unreleased bookings. The no-show rule should also be explained publicly.
translations.如果同一场地同一时段确实反复空着，最影响判断的是有没有现场时间和小程序截图；有人: If the same court at the same time really is repeatedly empty, timestamps and app screenshots matter most. Could someone add the date and court number?
translations.可以再加一项：记录同一块场地是否连续在小程序里不可约，并注明现场有没有维护、切场: Also record whether the same court stays unavailable in the app and whether maintenance, changeover or teaching signs are visible. That is easier to reproduce than a single observation of an empty court.
translations.想追问一下：如果预约成功但没到场，系统会自动核销还是一直占着？这个规则是所有场地: What happens if someone books but does not arrive: does the system clear it automatically or keep the slot occupied? Is that rule the same for all courts and slots?
translations.最烦的就是人到了却约不了，现场又像没人用。先把具体日期、时段和场地对上，至少能看: The most frustrating part is arriving and being unable to book when nobody seems to be there. Match the date, time and court first, so we can distinguish maintenance, a changeover and a booking not being released.
translations.我这边也想复现一下：如果有人记得具体日期、场地和截图，能否一起对照取消后多久释放: I would like to reproduce it too. Could someone share the date, court and screenshot, then compare how soon a cancellation is released? Match the time slot first to distinguish maintenance from an outdated booking status.
translations.如果取消后还长期显示不可约，确实不是小事；但先把具体日期、场地和时间段贴出来，管: If it stays unavailable long after cancellation, that is a real problem. First post the date, court and slot; management should also explain the cancellation and no-show rules.
translations.目前只能确认“空场但不可约”现象，内部占用原因仍未知。请提供具体运动、日期、时段: We can currently confirm reports of empty courts shown as unavailable; the cause remains unknown. Please provide the sport, date, time slot and court. We will gather comparable information across badminton, table tennis and different slots.
translations.服务台将核对可复现的未释放时段；目前尚不知是取消、未签到或维护导致。请提交具体场: The service desk will investigate reproducible unreleased slots. We do not yet know whether cancellations, no-shows or maintenance are responsible. Submit the court, date and slot; the service operator will report the queue status within one working day.
translations.已知现象是部分时段现场空置但小程序不可约，尚未知是否为取消未释放、未到场核销、维: The reported issue is empty courts shown as unavailable in the app. It is not yet clear whether unreleased cancellations, no-shows, maintenance or internal arrangements are involved. A verification notice will be issued, with a time-limited review of booking and on-site records.
translations.如果能补一条：同一场地在不可约期间是否一直空着，还是只在某个时间点看到空场？这能: One more detail: was that court empty throughout the unavailable period, or only at one moment? This helps distinguish continuous occupancy, an unreleased booking and a brief changeover.
translations.具体日期和场号能帮助复现，但我更想先知道：取消、过期或未签到后，场地按什么规则重: Dates and court numbers help reproduce it, but I first want to know the release rules after cancellation, expiry or a no-show. If those rules are not public, can management provide a clear explanation?
translations.我之前补充的维护、切场迹象也建议一起记下。另一个关键是：取消或未签到后，页面显示: Please also record the maintenance or changeover signs I mentioned. How long after cancellation or a no-show does the unavailable status remain? If sports or courts have different rules, compare them separately.
translations.这种空着却约不了的体验真的很憋屈。除了日期、场地和时段，也该记下页面显示持续了多: It is really frustrating when a court is empty but unavailable. Along with the date, court and slot, record how long the display stayed that way. Otherwise everyone is left guessing whether it was released.
translations.如果取消或过期后页面还不可约，能不能同时记下现场有没有维护、教学或切场标识？这样: If the page stays unavailable after cancellation or expiry, also record any maintenance, teaching or changeover signs. That separates an unreleased slot from a court where nobody happens to be playing at that moment.
translations.除了连续不可约，还可以记下现场是否有维护、切场或教学标识；若没有，再对照取消后多: Besides persistent unavailability, note any maintenance, changeover or teaching signs. If there are none, compare release times and check-in records to locate the step that failed.
translations.我也遇到过到场却约不了的情况，但现在最想知道：取消或未签到后，系统到底多久释放名: I have arrived and still been unable to book too. What I want to know now is how long after cancellation or a no-show the system releases the slot. A rule and a concrete record would help distinguish a protected slot from an outdated status.
translations.想确认下，预约成功但没到场时，名额是到点自动释放，还是要管理员手动核销？这个细节: If a person books but does not arrive, is the slot released automatically at a fixed time or cleared manually by an administrator? Can that distinction separate a stuck booking from a protected slot?
translations.这个记录维护、切场标识的办法挺实用。要是有人正好约不到，能不能把日期、场地、时段: Recording maintenance and changeover signs seems useful. If you cannot book, could you share the date, court, slot and app status? I want to check whether the empty-court observation really matches that slot.
translations.具体日期、场地和时段已经有人在追了，我更想问一个关键点：预约取消或过期后，系统通: Others are already asking for dates, courts and slots. My main question is how soon the system normally releases a cancelled or expired booking. Is that rule available?
translations.光看空场还是不够，最好把同一场地的预约状态、取消时间和现场维护/切场标识放在一起: An empty court is not enough on its own. Compare its booking status, cancellation time and maintenance or changeover signs together; otherwise responsibility remains unclear.
translations.未签到核销规则还没确认的话，能不能也记录同一块场地连续几天不可约、现场是否有维护: If the no-show rule is still unconfirmed, also record how many consecutive days the same court stays unavailable and whether teaching or maintenance signs are present. That helps rule out a temporary changeover.
translations.除了看多久释放，规则里有没有写未签到几分钟自动核销、同一规则是否覆盖羽毛球和乒乓: Beyond how long release takes, do the rules specify how many minutes after a missed check-in the booking is cleared, and whether the same rule covers badminton and table tennis? Otherwise comparisons across courts are hard to interpret.
translations.如果能把同一场地连续几个时段的“不可约”状态和现场标识一起记下，再看取消或过期后: Record the same court's unavailable status and on-site signs across consecutive slots, then check how soon availability returns after cancellation or expiry. That should separate maintenance locks from unreleased bookings; internal use cannot yet be established.
translations.可以把同一场地连续不可约的起止时间也记下来，尤其对照取消或过期预约后多久仍不释放: Record when persistent unavailability starts and ends, especially how long it continues after a cancellation or expiry. That distinguishes a brief changeover from a status stuck for a long time.
translations.可以把记录再做成对照表：同一场地同一时段连续几天的显示状态、现场标识，以及取消或: Could the records be put into a comparison table: display status for the same court and slot across several days, on-site signs, and time to availability after cancellation or expiry? That would distinguish protected slots from unreleased bookings.
translations.日期和场号可以继续补，但我更想先问清：取消或未签到后通常多久释放？如果规则本来就: Keep adding dates and court numbers, but how soon are cancellations or no-shows normally released? If the rules hold a court for a while, an empty court may not be abnormal.
translations.如果已经确认是同一块场地、同一时段，能不能再记一下取消或过期后页面多久刷新？这个: If it is definitely the same court and slot, record how soon the page refreshes after cancellation or expiry. That time may distinguish system lag from an intentional court lock.
translations.可以再补一项：记录同一场地是否反复显示不可约，以及现场有没有维护、切场或临时封闭: Also record whether the same court repeatedly appears unavailable and whether there are signs of maintenance, changeover or temporary closure. That separates unreleased bookings from changing on-site conditions.
translations.可以把“连续不可约”也记下来：同一场地同一时段连续几天显示不可约，再对照现场是否: Record persistent unavailability too: the same court and slot over several days, alongside maintenance or changeover signs. That better distinguishes brief use from an unreleased status.
translations.想确认下：取消后一直不可约，和预约成功但没到场，系统处理是同一套吗？如果未签到不: Does the system treat a cancellation that stays unavailable the same as a successful booking with no arrival? If no-shows are not automatically released, the empty court may simply remain reserved under the rules. We need specific records.
translations.除了问会不会自动核销，还想确认：未签到核销的具体时间点有没有公开？如果不同场地或: Besides whether it clears automatically, is the exact no-show clearance time public? If courts or slots follow different rules, please explain each.
translations.这种空场却不可约真的很憋屈，先别急着扣“内部占用”的帽子；但管理方至少该说清取消: Empty but unavailable courts are really frustrating. We should not immediately call it internal use, but management should at least explain how cancellation, no-show and maintenance slots are released.
translations.先别把“不可约”直接算成占位，但也不能只让大家自己猜。能否按日期、场地、时段公开: Unavailable does not automatically mean someone is holding the court, but people should not have to guess. Could a date-, court- and slot-specific review show maintenance or changeover status and release times after cancellation or a no-show?
translations.除了日期、场地和时段，能不能再记一下页面最后更新时间？不然过一会儿状态变了，现场: Along with the date, court and slot, could we record the page's last update time? If the status changes later, the on-site observation and the app may no longer match.
translations.我之前也倾向先记录场地和时段。再补一个：能不能把小程序显示“不可约”的截图时间，: I previously suggested recording the court and slot. One addition: put the screenshot time next to the time the empty court was seen. That makes it easier to check whether the observations refer to the same slot.
translations.可以把现场记录再细化成“时间、场地、预约状态、是否有维护或教学标识、随后何时恢复: Use a more detailed record: time, court, booking status, maintenance or teaching signs, and when booking became available again. That separates unreleased bookings from changeovers and helps management verify the issue.
translations.要是方便，能不能把同一块场地的具体日期和时段发出来？我想对照一下取消或超时后页面: Could you share the date and time for that same court? I want to compare how soon the page recovers after cancellation or timeout, to distinguish a normal lock from an unreleased booking.
translations.能不能再补一条：同一场地在不可约期间，现场是否有教学或维护标识？这能帮助排除只是: One more point: were there teaching or maintenance signs while that court was unavailable? That helps rule out a changeover or temporary arrangement.
translations.想确认一下：未签到自动核销是不是所有场地、时段都同一规则？如果规则不同，只看取消: Is automatic no-show clearance governed by the same rule for every court and slot? If not, cancellation release times alone may be insufficient for comparison.
translations.这个规则确实是关键。我自己也想知道：取消、过期和未签到分别多久释放？如果服务台能: That rule really is crucial. How soon are cancellations, expired bookings and no-shows each released? If the service desk can check, please explain which courts it covers and any exceptions.
translations.可以再加一项：记录取消或过期后同一时段何时恢复可约。这样才好区分维护锁场和预约状: Also record when that same slot becomes bookable after cancellation or expiry. That separates maintenance locks from unreleased bookings before assigning responsibility.
translations.这种空场却不可约确实很憋屈。我之前也说过，光凭现象还不能断定是内部占用；如果连取: It really is frustrating. As I said before, the observation alone does not establish internal use. If users cannot even find cancellation or expiry release times, they are left guessing.
translations.我前面也倾向先记录同一场地同一时段；现在还应把取消、过期和未签到后的自动释放时限: I also suggested starting with records for the same court and slot. Now we should establish automatic release times after cancellation, expiry and no-shows. Otherwise internal use and unreleased status remain indistinguishable.
translations.除了预约和取消时间，现场有没有可公开核对的维护或切场标识？不然连续不可约也还是分: Besides booking and cancellation times, are there publicly checkable maintenance or changeover signs? Persistent unavailability still does not distinguish a normal lock from an unreleased booking.
translations.如果记录到取消或过期后仍不可约，现场标识也显示非维护、教学或切场，那能否请服务台: If cancellation or expiry is followed by continued unavailability, with no maintenance, teaching or changeover indicated, could the service desk publish the release rule and verification result for that slot?
translations.连续不可约的起止时间还应和取消、过期、未签到记录对照；不然就算复现了，也分不清是: Compare the beginning and end of persistent unavailability with cancellation, expiry and no-show records. Even reproducing it will not otherwise distinguish a normal lock from an unreleased booking.
translations.如果服务台能给出取消、过期和未签到分别多久释放，最好也说明谁能查到核销记录；不然: If the desk can provide release times for cancellations, expiry and no-shows, please also say who can access clearance records. Otherwise reproducing the issue still will not identify the step that failed.
translations.还可以顺手对照羽毛球和乒乓球：取消、过期和未签到的释放规则是否一致？若规则不同，: Compare badminton and table tennis too: are cancellation, expiry and no-show release rules the same? If not, empty and unavailable courts alone do not locate the bottleneck.
translations.那能不能先明确一下：取消、过期和未签到分别在什么节点释放？如果规则本来不同，后面: Could we first clarify the release point for cancellation, expiry and no-shows? If the rules differ, we can record them separately; otherwise it is difficult to locate the stuck step.
translations.我前面也在追场地、时段和释放规则。现在想确认一下：羽毛球、乒乓球是不是共用同一套: I have been asking about courts, slots and release rules. Do badminton and table tennis share the same automatic no-show release rule? If not, could you provide a separate reference for each?
translations.未签到会自动核销这点，具体是所有场地和时段都一样吗？如果规则只覆盖部分场地，连续: Is automatic no-show clearance the same for all courts and slots? If it only covers some courts, persistent unavailability cannot all be explained the same way.
translations.前面已经提到不同场地对照了，我想再补一个可复核点：能否记录预约状态从成功、取消或: We have discussed comparisons across courts. Also record the time from a successful, cancelled or expired booking to renewed availability. If no-shows are automatically cleared, specify the number of minutes. That tests release delays better than occupancy alone.
translations.场地和时段对应关系既然在核对，那还差一个会直接影响判断的点：预约人未签到或过期后: While matching courts and slots, one crucial question remains: how long does the system take to release a no-show or expired booking? Can that limit be looked up?
translations.释放规则如果能查到，是否也有对应的实际记录可核对？比如取消或过期后状态多久恢复、: If the release rules are available, are there actual records to check against them: recovery after cancellation or expiry, and consistency across courts? Rules alone do not show where this particular case got stuck.
translations.我前面也只敢说是“空场且不可约”，还不能推到内部占用。要是有人方便，能不能帮忙补: I have only described an empty, unavailable court, not established internal use. Could someone add the date, slot and time the same court became bookable again? I would like to ask management using that information.
translations.未签到自动核销如果按场地或时段分别设置，取消后的释放时间也可能不同。能否各选一块: If no-show clearance is configured by court or slot, cancellation release times may differ too. Could we test one badminton court and one table-tennis area under comparable rules?
translations.我也遇到过这种空着却约不了的憋屈感。除了看现场标识，能不能把取消、未签到后的释放: I have felt that frustration too. Besides checking signs, can we explain the release rules after cancellation and no-shows? Otherwise everyone keeps guessing.
translations.如果未签到也一直占着名额，这就不只是切场问题了。能否公布该时段的签到、自动核销和: If a no-show continues holding the slot, this goes beyond a changeover. Could check-in, automatic clearance and reopening times for that slot be published?
translations.未签到核销如果确实存在，具体是到点立刻释放，还是过一段时间才释放？这个时间点有公: If no-show clearance exists, does it release immediately or after a delay? Is the timing publicly stated, and could badminton and table tennis differ?
translations.如果能给出取消、过期后页面恢复的实际时间点就更好了；不然同一时段反复看，还是分不: Actual page-recovery times after cancellation or expiry would help. Rechecking the same slot alone still does not distinguish a normal lock from an unreleased booking.
translations.如果某时段确有教学或维护，现场标识能不能和预约记录对应上？尤其想知道取消、未签到: If a slot is reserved for teaching or maintenance, do the signs match its booking record? I especially want to know whether cancellation and no-show release times are consistent, to rule out temporary locks.
translations.把小程序截图时间和现场到场时间并排记录很有用。还想问下：如果能确认是同一场地同一: Putting screenshot and arrival times side by side is useful. If they refer to the same court and slot, can management retrieve the release time after cancellation or a no-show?
translations.如果现场确实空着，能不能顺手确认一下有没有维护、教学或切场标识？这个比单看小程序: If the court really is empty, could you check for maintenance, teaching or changeover signs? That helps judge a normal lock better than the app alone.
translations.除了记录同一场地同一时段，也建议把羽毛球、乒乓球分别列样本；如果不同项目的未签到: Along with matching courts and slots, list badminton and table-tennis samples separately. If no-show or cancellation rules differ, this prevents a cross-sport comparison from mistaking rule differences for held slots.
translations.我前面也在记场地和时段了。能不能再约同一时间复看一次，并把页面更新时间、现场标识: I have been recording courts and slots too. Could we arrange another check at the same time and note page updates, signs and whether anyone is using the court? I do not want to mistake a changeover for a held booking.
translations.现场标识这点能排除一部分切场或维护。那不可约期间有没有预约核销、取消或自动释放的: Signs can rule out some maintenance or changeovers. Are clearance, cancellation or automatic release records available for the unavailable period?
translations.可以再记一下：同一时段隔几分钟刷新，状态有没有变化；若取消后仍长期不可约，才更像: Refresh every few minutes within the same slot and record status changes. If it remains unavailable long after cancellation, that looks more like a system issue worth reporting.
translations.除了释放时限，规则里有没有写未签到是否自动取消？如果没有，现场空着但页面不放号就: Besides release timing, do the rules say whether no-shows are automatically cancelled? Without that, an empty court with no slots offered is difficult to distinguish from a normal lock.
translations.如果有人有连续几天同一场地、同一时段的截图，最好把取消或超时后的页面变化也记下来: If someone has screenshots of the same court and slot across several days, also record page changes after cancellation or timeout. That would separate fixed locks from unreleased bookings faster.
translations.现有信息只能确认“空场但不可约”现象，尚不能判断是取消未释放、未签到还是维护。请: Current information confirms reports of empty courts shown as unavailable, but not whether unreleased cancellations, no-shows or maintenance are responsible. Submit the court, date and slot, with badminton and table-tennis records compared separately.
translations.服务运营将核对可复现的未释放时段，并在1个工作日内反馈队列状态；目前尚不确定原因: The service operator will investigate reproducible unreleased slots and report queue status within one working day. The cause is still uncertain; please submit the court, date and time slot.
translations.已知是空场与小程序不可约现象，尚不知由取消未释放、未签到或维护造成。将发布受限预: The known issue is empty courts shown as unavailable in the app; cancellation, no-show and maintenance causes remain unresolved. A limited booking-evidence statement will be published and reviewed by venue operations within one working day.
translations.可以把释放节点和现场记录放在同一张表里：取消、过期、未签到分别记时间，再看羽毛球: Put release points and on-site records in one table: cancellation, expiry and no-show times, then compare delays for badminton and table tennis. That locates an update failure better than guessing about internal use.
translations.我也不想把空场直接等同于内部占用。能不能先确认羽毛球和乒乓球的未签到释放时限是否: I also do not want to equate empty courts with internal use. Can we first check whether badminton and table tennis have the same no-show release time? If they differ, users cannot tell a rule from an outdated status.
translations.如果能查到记录，能不能把取消、过期和未签到分开看？我更想知道实际状态多久恢复、核: If records are accessible, examine cancellations, expiry and no-shows separately. I want actual recovery times and clearance records tied to slots, to distinguish rules from a system update failure.
translations.规则本身还不能说明这次具体卡在哪。未签到自动释放后，后台或小程序有没有可核对的状: The rule itself does not locate this failure. After automatic no-show release, can the backend or app show a verifiable status-change time? Even anonymised slot records would help distinguish a rule-related delay from a changeover.
translations.还可以补一项：释放后再刷新一次，看同一场地时段是否恢复可约，并记录恢复时间。这样: Refresh once more after release and record whether and when the same slot becomes bookable. That separates a written rule from a status that actually updates.
translations.如果确认过期或取消后仍不可约，能不能同时查到这段时间的签到、核销或占用类型？这样: If the slot remains unavailable after confirmed expiry or cancellation, can we also check its check-in, clearance or occupancy category during that period? That separates delayed release from another valid lock.
translations.这种到场却约不了真的很憋屈。除了看释放时限，最好把一次具体时段的取消、未签到和系: Arriving and being unable to book is really frustrating. Beyond release limits, match cancellation, no-show and system-status changes for a specific slot to find where it got stuck.
translations.日期、时段和场地先对上没问题；同一时段能不能再留一份小程序状态前后截图或记录？这: Matching date, time and court makes sense. Could we also keep before-and-after app screenshots for that slot? That distinguishes maintenance changes from an unreleased booking.
translations.如果现场确实空着，能否把同一时段的小程序状态和现场核对记录对应起来？这样才知道是: If it really is empty, can the app status and on-site check for that slot be matched? That would show whether it was unreleased or whether the observation was outside a bookable period.
translations.羽毛球和乒乓球如果规则不一样，能不能分别说明未签到、过期后多久释放？我最近主要是: If badminton and table tennis have different rules, explain their no-show and expiry release times separately. I mainly want to book a court and do not know when I should refresh.
translations.规则写明未签到会自动释放的话，这次有没有实际状态记录能对上？比如到点后多久恢复可: If the rules promise automatic no-show release, is there an actual status record for this case? How soon did it become bookable, or is there only a rule with no slot-specific evidence?
translations.如果现场确有维护或切场，至少该有能核对的标识；没有的话，连续不可约又看着空着，普: If there is maintenance or a changeover, there should at least be checkable signs. Without them, persistent unavailability and an empty court leave people guessing and make booking miserable.
translations.如果两类场地共用规则，最好再对照一条实际记录：未签到后状态何时恢复、是否有例外。: If both sports share the rule, compare an actual record: when availability returns after a no-show and whether exceptions exist. That distinguishes the rule itself from one failed update.
translations.如果羽毛球和乒乓球的未签到核销时限不同，能不能分别说明？不然拿一种场地的规则解释: If badminton and table tennis have different no-show clearance limits, explain them separately. Applying one court type's rule to all persistent unavailability could be misleading.
translations.羽毛球和乒乓球若共用规则，应该能找到同一个说明入口；若不共用，分别给规则页面或工: If badminton and table tennis share the rule, there should be one reference page. Otherwise separate rule pages or service-ticket guidance would make verification easier.
translations.未签到会在什么节点自动核销、名额多久重新开放？如果这项记录能对上，才能判断是正常: When is a no-show automatically cleared, and how soon does the slot reopen? Matching that record is what distinguishes a protected slot from an unreleased booking, right?
translations.如果方便的话，能不能把某次取消、超时或预约成功后的页面变化记下来？我现在最卡的是: Could you record page changes after a cancellation, timeout or successful booking? My main problem is not knowing who to ask. Clearance records would also help rule out simply checking the wrong court.
translations.我也觉得关键不只是现场空不空，而是取消或未签到后页面到底多久释放。要是同一场地反: I agree that the key is not just whether it is empty, but how soon the page releases the slot after cancellation or a no-show. Repeated cancelled-but-unavailable cases on the same court would support a more concrete system report.
translations.现场空着却一直不可约，确实很让人憋屈。除了查日志，也该把未签到、取消和自动释放的: It is frustrating to see an empty court stay unavailable. Besides checking logs, explain no-show, cancellation and automatic release rules; otherwise people can only guess whether someone is holding it.
translations.可以把日期、场地、时段、刷新或取消后的状态整理成一张表，再一起提交给管理方；这样: Put dates, courts, slots and status after refreshing or cancelling into one table and submit it together. That is easier to reproduce than one empty-court report and may reveal concentration in certain slots.
translations.还可以专门记一次“取消或超时后多久恢复可约”。如果页面一直不变，才更像未释放；若: Specifically record how long after cancellation or timeout the slot becomes bookable. An unchanged page suggests a release issue; recovery at a fixed time may reflect the normal rule.
translations.现场有维护、教学或切场标识的话，能不能也记下对应的具体场地和时段？这样才好和小程: If there are maintenance, teaching or changeover signs, record the specific court and slot too, so they can be matched to the app's unavailable status.
translations.如果核销或取消记录也查不到，能否先确认小程序是否保留这类状态变化？否则仅凭现场空: If clearance or cancellation records cannot be found, first confirm whether the app retains these status changes. An empty court alone cannot show which release step failed.
translations.如果取消或超时后页面仍要很久才恢复，约场时确实会一直误判成满场；这个恢复时限目前: If recovery takes a long time after cancellation or timeout, users may keep mistaking it for a fully booked court. Is there a clear recovery-time rule?
translations.同一场地同一时段的截图很关键，但还得有人把取消前后、超时后的页面变化记全。要是一: Screenshots of the same court and slot matter, but someone also needs the complete before-and-after cancellation and timeout changes. If it stays unavailable with no clearance or release record, management should at least explain the gap.
translations.羽毛球和乒乓球分开记很有必要。我更想看跨日期、跨场地是否都复现：如果只集中在某项: Separate badminton and table-tennis records are necessary. I want to see whether it reproduces across dates and courts. Concentration in one sport or slot could reflect rules; continued unavailability after cancellation can be reported separately as a system issue.
translations.除了按场地、时段复现，未签到自动核销的具体时限或规则有公开说明吗？如果没有，现场: Besides court- and slot-specific reproduction, is there a public rule or exact time limit for automatic no-show clearance? Without it, an empty court still does not distinguish a held slot from an unreleased booking.
translations.未签到会自动取消的话，具体是到点后多久释放？如果规则没写清，能否先给个可核对的时: If a no-show is automatically cancelled, how long after the start is the slot released? If the rule is unclear, provide a checkable time point to distinguish a normal lock from an unreleased booking.
translations.我也想把这几项对上，但不太清楚普通使用者能从哪里看到取消、核销或自动释放时间。有: I want to match those records too, but where can ordinary users see cancellation, clearance or automatic release times? Does anyone know the query page, or could management provide a de-identified record?
translations.如果能提供一条匿名复现记录，按“预约状态—取消或过期时间—现场标识—恢复可约时间: An anonymous reproduction record laid out as booking status, cancellation or expiry time, on-site signs, and renewed availability would locate a synchronisation failure better than an empty-court observation.
translations.羽毛球和乒乓球的未签到核销时限现在有能对照的规则吗？我前面也只是把空场当线索，不: Are there comparable rules for badminton and table-tennis no-show clearance times? I see the empty court as a clue and do not want to apply one sport's explanation to another. Records should specify their courts and slots.
translations.光核对现场和小程序还不够，最憋屈的是取消或过期后到底多久释放。把这个时限和对应记: Checking the site against the app is not enough. The frustrating question is how soon cancellation or expiry leads to release. Establishing that limit and the matching record would show whether the system is holding things up.
translations.可以按“同一场地同一时段”做几次对应记录：截图小程序状态，再记现场是否空置、是否: Repeat matched observations for the same court and slot: screenshot the app, note occupancy and maintenance signs. That can distinguish an unreleased booking from a court that has changed over.
translations.这点有用，但别只记“刷新后能不能约”：连续不可约的起止时间、刷新时间和场地编号也: Useful, but do not just record whether refreshing makes booking possible. Match the start and end of unavailability, refresh times and court number. Otherwise nobody can explain where an empty, unavailable court got stuck.
translations.如果服务台能核对到具体未释放时段，是否也能说明预约取消、过期和未签到分别何时释放: If the desk can identify a specific unreleased slot, can it also explain when cancellation, expiry and no-shows each trigger release? Otherwise the empty, unavailable court still does not identify the bottleneck.
translations.如果要核对，能否先固定同一块场地和同一时段，记录现场空置、小程序状态及之后多久恢: For verification, fix one court and time slot and record occupancy, app status and time to recovery. That separates maintenance changeovers from unreleased bookings.
translations.我前面已经问过场地、时段和释放规则了，这里再卡一个点：羽毛球和乒乓球的未签到、过: I have already asked about courts, slots and release rules. Do badminton and table tennis really share no-show and expiry rules? If not, provide separate rule references or ticket guidance; otherwise a release failure is hard to distinguish from a sport-specific lock.
translations.我前面也把空场当成线索，不是结论。能不能直接说羽毛球、乒乓球各自未签到后多久释放: I have treated an empty court as a clue, not a conclusion. Can you directly state each sport's no-show release time? If they match, we know when to refresh; if not, label them separately.
translations.我还是不太会把“空场”直接判成内部占用。更关键的是挑一个具体时段，看不可约状态在: I would not infer internal use from an empty court alone. Pick a specific slot and check status changes after cancellation or a no-show. Persistent non-release looks more like a system or process issue.
translations.如果确实是维护或切场，能否看到预约状态最后一次变更时间？这样能区分一直锁着，还是: If it really is maintenance or a changeover, can we see the booking status's last change time? That distinguishes a continuous lock from a temporary changeover that was not released.
translations.如果是释放延迟，能否说明系统里显示的释放状态或预计恢复时间？不需要个人信息，有这: If release is delayed, can the system show release status or expected recovery time? No personal information is needed; a timestamp would help.
translations.如果能查到核销记录，最好也按项目分别看：羽毛球和乒乓球的释放时限、状态更新时间是: If clearance records are available, compare them by sport: are release limits and status-update times the same? One sport's rule cannot explain another if they differ.
translations.如果有人愿意复现，能不能把日期、具体场地和预约状态截图对应起来？我最想知道的是：: If someone can reproduce it, match the date, exact court and booking screenshot. I most want to know how long after cancellation or expiry the system releases it, so I can tell a rule from a fault in my own case.
translations.如果管理端暂时不能给完整日志，能否至少说明取消或超时后系统应在多久核销、普通用户: If management cannot provide full logs yet, at least explain the expected clearance time after cancellation or timeout and whether users can see status changes. That separates non-release from a changeover.
translations.除了看页面何时恢复，能不能把同一场地的取消时间、未签到核销和重新可约时间对上？不: Beyond when the page recovers, match the cancellation time, no-show clearance and renewed availability for the same court. Unavailable alone cannot distinguish a normal lock from non-release.
translations.如果要继续对，建议把同一场地的取消或未签到时间、页面重新可约时间各记一笔；只要这: For further checks, record cancellation or no-show time and renewed availability separately for the same court. Reproducing that delay identifies the problem better than speculation about internal use.
translations.如果未签到会自动取消，能不能明确是到预约开始后几分钟释放？这个时间点最方便普通人: If no-shows are cancelled automatically, specify how many minutes after the booking starts the slot is released. That is the easiest point for ordinary users to check on site.
translations.维护或教学标识记具体场地和时段很有用。那取消或超时后，羽毛球和乒乓球的释放时限是: Recording the court and slot for teaching or maintenance signs is useful. Are badminton and table-tennis release limits after cancellation or timeout identical?
translations.如果取消或超时后页面还要很久才恢复，能否明确显示预计释放时间？至少这样大家能区分: If page recovery takes a long time after cancellation or timeout, can it show an expected release time? That would separate full occupancy from system lag, without turning a clue into a conclusion about internal use.
translations.如果小程序确实保留取消或过期状态，能不能查一个具体时段的脱敏记录？这样才好判断是: If the app retains cancellation or expiry status, could we check a de-identified record for one specific slot? That helps distinguish non-release from a temporary lock.
translations.可以再补一项：记录取消或超时后页面恢复可约的具体分钟数，连续记几次更有区分度。若: Also record the exact minutes until booking becomes available after cancellation or timeout, across several cases. If it never recovers, submit screenshots and the timeline to management together.
translations.如果已经有人复现，能不能把同一块场地的日期、项目和具体时段对齐？不同项目可能规则: If someone has reproduced it, align the date, sport and exact slot for the same court. Different sports may follow different rules; comparable conditions are needed to distinguish a normal lock from non-release.
translations.如果管理端暂时不能公开完整记录，能否至少说明取消或超时后通常多久释放？有了这个时: If full records cannot yet be public, at least explain the usual release time after cancellation or timeout. That helps distinguish a normal lock from an outdated booking status.
translations.表格思路可以，但我不太会判断哪些截图才算有效复现。能否先约定最少记录项，比如场地: The table idea works, but I do not know which screenshots count as useful reproduction evidence. Could we agree on minimum fields such as court, slot, page status and refresh time? I can add a record in that format.
translations.能查取消和自动释放已经说到点上了。要是普通用户既看不到核销状态，也等不到异常回执: Checking cancellation and automatic release gets to the point. If ordinary users see neither clearance status nor a response to an issue report, an empty, unavailable court only gets more frustrating. Publish these rules first.
translations.空场本身还不能证明有人占位，但如果未签到后一直不释放，就不是“看错场地”这么简单: An empty court alone does not prove someone is holding it. But if no-shows are never released, it is more than checking the wrong court. Publish the clearance trigger and release records so users can verify them.
translations.我已经记了场地、时段和现场对应关系，但现在卡在核对上：取消、未签到和维护分别有没: I have recorded courts, slots and on-site observations, but now need to verify them. Are status or time records available separately for cancellation, no-shows and maintenance? Can someone point me to them?
translations.不同项目、时段如果适用不同核销或释放规则，最好把规则差异也标出来；否则只看空场和: If sports and slots follow different clearance or release rules, identify those differences. Otherwise empty and unavailable courts still cannot distinguish a normal lock from non-release.
translations.我之前一直在追场地、时段和释放规则，这点目前还没问清。有人能确认羽毛球和乒乓球未: I have kept asking about courts, slots and release rules, and this remains unclear. Can anyone confirm the separate badminton and table-tennis release times after a no-show or expiry?
translations.不同项目如果共用一套释放规则，复现时可以直接对照；如果羽毛球和乒乓球不同，最好分: If sports share one release rule, reproduction records can be compared directly. If badminton and table tennis differ, record them separately to avoid treating rule differences as system faults.
translations.状态前后记录有了的话，再补一个关键点：预约者未签到后，系统有没有明确的核销和释放: If before-and-after status records are available, add one crucial check: does the system have a clear clearance and release time limit after a missed check-in?
translations.如果刷新后恢复可约，也建议记下恢复前后的时间和场地号；这样能区分临时切场、维护，: If refreshing restores availability, record the time and court number before and after. That distinguishes changeovers, maintenance and delayed cancellation release. One recovery does not mean the whole problem is solved.
translations.这条复现记录思路比较实。还想确认一个点：预约成功但到点没签到，系统有没有明确的核: This reproduction-record approach is practical. One more question: does the system specify when an unchecked-in booking is cleared or released? Otherwise the empty court and unavailable status still cannot be tied to a particular step.
translations.这种空着却约不了真的很憋屈。除了截图，最好把取消、过期、未签到后的释放时限分别说: Empty but unbookable courts are really frustrating. Besides screenshots, explain release limits separately for cancellations, expiry and no-shows. Otherwise people keep refreshing without knowing where things are stuck.
translations.按项目分开看很有必要。要是能把核销记录和具体日期、场地、时段对应起来，就能先判断: Separate sports need separate checks. Matching clearance records to dates, courts and slots would show whether a no-show was not released or was never cleared at all. How much of those matched records can be public?
translations.除了核销时限，能不能查到某个具体时段取消或过期后的状态变更时间？这样才好区分一直: Besides clearance limits, can we find the status-change time after cancellation or expiry for a specific slot? That distinguishes a continuous lock from a booking that ended but was not released.
translations.状态最后变更时间很关键，但还要把维护、切场标记和预约释放记录对上；不然只看到“不: The last status-change time matters, but match it to maintenance or changeover markers and release records. An unchanged unavailable display still cannot distinguish a valid lock from system non-release.
translations.现场有没有维护或切场标识，也可以顺手记下小程序显示状态的最后变更时间；这样能分清: Alongside maintenance or changeover signs, note the app status's last change time. That distinguishes a continuous lock from a temporary changeover that was not released.
translations.未签到释放规则如果能按项目、时段各复现一次，会比继续猜“内部占用”更有区分度。尤: Reproducing the no-show release rule by sport and slot is more informative than guessing about internal use. Record the exact switch from unavailable to bookable; if it never changes, ask whether maintenance or protected slots apply.
translations.除了释放时限，系统能不能显示这条预约状态最后一次变更时间？不用个人信息，有时间点: Besides the release limit, can the system show when this booking status last changed? A timestamp, without personal information, would distinguish a continuous lock from non-release after cancellation.
translations.那能不能给一个具体时段，核对取消或未签到后状态何时释放？如果没有记录，怎么判断是: Could we take a specific slot and check when its status releases after cancellation or a no-show? Without a record, how can we distinguish the rule from a release failure?
translations.不同项目的取消、超时释放规则是统一的吗？如果羽毛球和乒乓球不一样，页面能不能分别: Are cancellation and timeout release rules uniform across sports? If badminton and table tennis differ, show them separately on the page so rule differences are not mistaken for internal slot-holding.
translations.现场标识和小程序能对应上后，最关键还是未签到多久自动释放吧？羽毛球、乒乓球的时限: Once signs and app records match, the key is still how long a missed check-in takes to trigger release, right? Is that limit shared by badminton and table tennis or configured separately?
translations.项目和时段规则差异确实是关键。再补一个容易漏的点：如果同一场地同一时段反复出现，: Sport- and slot-specific rules are crucial. Another easily missed detail: for repeated cases on the same court and slot, record page status and on-site time to see whether no-shows remain unreleased. That locates the issue better than internal-use speculation.
translations.如果能拿到同一场地的取消/未签到时间和重新可约时间，基本就能先排除“只是看错场地: Cancellation or no-show times and renewed availability for the same court would largely rule out checking the wrong court. For now, all we can say is that the release process is unverified.
translations.没有核销或释放回执，约不到的人确实很憋屈；但空场也不能直接扣成内部占用。至少把取: No clearance or release receipt is frustrating for people unable to book, but empty courts do not establish internal use. Show cancellation, no-show and maintenance states with release times so users can check.
translations.我已经记了场地、时段和现场情况，但下一步具体该去哪看核销、取消和自动释放记录？如: I have recorded the court, slot and site conditions. Where exactly do I now find clearance, cancellation and automatic release records? If users cannot access them, give us a submission channel and a receipt deadline.
translations.如果有人能查到，最关键的可能是某个时段的核销状态和实际释放时间：这两项有没有面向: If anyone can access them, clearance status and actual release time for one slot may be the crucial details. Is there a user-facing way to query those two items?
translations.如果能分别看到取消、未签到、维护三种状态的释放时间，应该比只看现场空不空更容易定: Seeing separate release times for cancellation, no-show and maintenance states would locate the problem better than occupancy alone. I have also followed page recovery, but those three categories should not be mixed.
translations.如果是未签到占着名额，能不能把释放时间直接显示在预约规则里？我想按同一场地、同一: If no-shows hold slots, can release times be displayed directly in the booking rules? I want to check the same court and slot on site instead of guessing from unavailable.
translations.如果未签到一直不释放，能不能查到具体的核销时间和释放时间？最好按场地、时段展示，: If no-shows remain unreleased, can we retrieve exact clearance and release times, preferably by court and slot? Otherwise a normal lock and an unreleased booking remain indistinguishable.
translations.如果有人已经记了几次，能不能顺手标下取消/超时后页面何时恢复可约？我想知道是偶发: If someone has several records, add when availability returns after cancellation or timeout. I want to know whether it is an occasional delay or persistent non-release. Screenshots and a timeline would help with submission.
translations.如果能选一个具体时段，看到取消或过期后何时释放、是否被重新锁定，就能先排除一部分: A specific slot showing when it released after cancellation or expiry, and whether it was locked again, would rule out some misinterpretations. Can anyone access such de-identified records?
translations.场地和时段对齐后，未签到这条也很关键：预约成功但没到场，系统会在什么节点自动核销: After matching court and slot, the no-show case matters: when does the system automatically clear and release a booking if nobody arrives? Is the rule public, or must an administrator retrieve it?
translations.别只让大家继续截图，关键是取消后页面到底多久恢复可约。这个时间若没有记录，用户一: Do not just keep asking people for screenshots. The key is how soon booking returns after cancellation. Without that time record, users keep failing to book and nobody can be held responsible.
translations.项目规则要分开看没错。能不能再贴一个具体日期、项目和时段，并记下最后一次不可约的: Yes, compare sport rules separately. Could you also post the date, sport and slot, plus the last time it was unavailable? That can be matched against cancellation or no-show release records.
translations.羽毛球和乒乓球的释放规则会一样吗？我想按项目各记一次取消、过期和未签到后的状态变: Are badminton and table-tennis release rules the same? I want to record changes after cancellation, expiry and no-shows for each sport, otherwise I still cannot distinguish rule differences from non-release.
translations.未签到后的核销时限也建议单独测一次：预约成功、到点不签到，记录多久恢复可约。这样: Test the no-show clearance limit separately too: make a booking, miss check-in at the start and record how soon it becomes available. That separates nobody using a court from a system failing to release it.
translations.可以先盯一个具体时段：记录取消或未签到的时间，再看小程序何时恢复可约。要是状态一: Focus on one slot first: record cancellation or no-show time and when the app becomes bookable. An unchanged status suggests non-release; recovery at a fixed limit could rule out some internal-use guesses.
translations.如果取消或过期后的释放时限查到了，能不能再按羽毛球、乒乓球各固定一个同日期时段复: If cancellation or expiry release limits are available, reproduce one same-date slot for badminton and another for table tennis. That distinguishes sport-specific rules from the same type of stuck status.
translations.状态最后变更时间有了，但能不能和维护、切场这些标记一起看？不然知道它没变，也还是: We have the last status-change time, but can it be checked alongside maintenance and changeover markers? Knowing the status did not change still does not distinguish a valid lock from a booking stuck after cancellation.
translations.我之前也在看取消、过期和未签到的差异。可以再补一项：同一场地连续刷新并截图状态变: I have also been comparing cancellation, expiry and no-shows. Repeatedly refresh the same court and screenshot status-change times. A stable release time suggests a rule; an unchanged status makes a system report more worthwhile.
translations.记录恢复前后的时间很重要，但还得把“未签到后是否自动核销、谁能查到核销记录”说清: Recording before-and-after recovery times matters, but also clarify whether no-shows clear automatically and who can retrieve clearance records. Otherwise students cannot book and management cannot readily show which release step failed.
translations.这个点真的很关键。要是未签到后一直不释放，现场空着却约不了确实很憋屈；先看具体项: That really matters. If no-shows never release, an empty but unbookable court is frustrating. Reproduce it for a specific sport and slot before deciding whether it is a rule or release failure.
translations.如果能拿一个具体场地和时段，看看取消或未签到后状态有没有按规则变回可约，就能先排: For a specific court and slot, checking whether status returns to bookable as required after cancellation or a no-show would rule out some continuous-lock explanations. Can anyone retrieve that change time?
translations.未签到核销规则前面有人问了；现在更关键的是，能不能拿一条实际记录说明状态何时释放: Someone already asked about the no-show rule. Now an actual record showing when status released matters more. A written rule alone cannot tell whether this case is a normal lock or non-release.
translations.如果服务台能公布一个已复现的未签到时段，以及从预约时间到重新可约的时间点，就能判: If the desk publishes a reproduced no-show slot and the timeline from booking to renewed availability, we could distinguish a rule-based lock from non-release. Are such records available now?
translations.我也想按具体日期和时段复现，但现在最难的是看不到状态变更记录。能否先说明维护切换: I want to reproduce a specific date and slot too, but the main obstacle is not seeing status-change records. Could we first clarify whether maintenance changes have markers, to distinguish non-release from normal locks?
translations.没回执真的很憋屈，大家也没法判断到底是延迟还是占位。至少先给个提交入口和处理时限: No receipt is really frustrating; people cannot tell delay from someone holding the slot. At least provide a submission channel and response deadline, instead of leaving everyone to collect screenshots alone.
translations.如果取消或超时后确实会释放，页面是否能留下对应时间记录？没有这条记录，现场空着和: If cancellation or timeout really releases a slot, can the page retain a corresponding time record? Without it, empty courts and unavailable app status do not show which step failed.
translations.如果页面显示已取消，但后台仍不可约，能不能查到实际释放时间和是否被再次锁定？没有: If the page says cancelled but the backend still says unavailable, can we retrieve the actual release time and whether it was locked again? An empty court alone cannot distinguish delayed release from a changeover.
translations.同一时段如果能看到取消或过期后的释放时间，应该最容易分辨是系统延迟还是有人一直占: Seeing a slot's release time after cancellation or expiry should best distinguish system lag from someone continuously holding it. Can anyone provide a de-identified timeline?
translations.我之前已经追问过日期、时段和释放规则了。要是有人准备交复现表，能不能顺手记下同一: I have already asked about dates, slots and release rules. If someone is submitting a reproduction table, record how soon the same court's page recovers after cancellation, expiry and no-shows separately. That helps management locate the issue without assuming internal use.
translations.我前面一直在追问释放时间；这里再确认一下，不同项目的取消、超时规则到底是否一致？: I have kept asking about release times. Are cancellation and timeout rules actually consistent across sports? If not, the page should clearly separate badminton from table tennis.
translations.我也想核对，但现在不知道该怎么查。有人愿意一起选一个具体日期和场地，记录取消/超: I want to check too but do not know how. Would anyone pick a date and court with me and record recovery after cancellation or timeout? A complete timeline would distinguish delay from continuous slot-holding.
translations.可以拿一两个具体场地做时间线：取消或过期后每隔几分钟刷新一次，记下何时恢复可约。: Build timelines for one or two courts: refresh every few minutes after cancellation or expiry and record when booking returns. That separates delayed release from continuous occupancy better than a photo of an empty court.
translations.我也最想看这个时间线：同一场地同一时段，记录取消或超时后页面何时恢复。若只是延迟: That is the timeline I most want: for the same court and slot, when does the page recover after cancellation or timeout? Delayed release should be distinguishable from a slot remaining locked.
translations.未签到后的核销、释放时间如果能按场地和时段公开，大家就不用靠空场去猜是不是占位；: If no-show clearance and release times were public by court and slot, people would not need to infer slot-holding from empty courts. That crucial record is still unavailable.
translations.除了看页面何时恢复可约，最好把“未签到后何时自动核销”单独记下来：同一场地、同一: Besides page recovery, record automatic no-show clearance time separately. Repeated checks for the same court and slot are needed to distinguish rule-based locks from release delays.
translations.能否选一个具体场地和时段，对一下取消或未签到时间、核销状态，以及页面恢复可约的时: Could we pick one court and slot and compare cancellation or no-show time, clearance status and page recovery? That would reveal delayed release versus another pre-existing lock.
translations.可以先选一个具体场地和时段，连续记下取消、超时、维护后的页面状态及恢复时间；不同: Start with one court and slot, repeatedly recording page status and recovery after cancellation, timeout and maintenance. Compare sports separately when their rules differ, so mechanism differences are not mistaken for slot-holding.
translations.这个问题我也想核对：取消或超时后，页面通常多久恢复可约？能否拿同一场地同一时段的: I want to check this too: how long after cancellation or timeout does the page normally become bookable? Compare time records for the same court and slot so display lag is not mistaken for internal use.
translations.不同项目的未签到释放时限如果不一样，取消或过期后页面恢复可约的时间也能公开吗？不: If no-show release limits differ across sports, can recovery times after cancellation or expiry also be published? Otherwise an empty court still leaves normal locks and non-release hard to distinguish.
